After almost a year of increasing tension, a full scale Warsaw Pact offensive is launched into Western Europe. BATTLEFIELD GERMANY has begun!

BATTLEFIELD GERMANY is a simulation game about a conflict that has yet to happen — war in central Europe between NATO and the WARSAW PACT. Under the shadow of nuclear escalation, the war encompasses both West and East Germany, Czechoslovakia, Belgium, the Netherlands and Eastern France.

463712.overview:
A competitive game for two ... Spectrum Bowls is designed to mirror the conventional game of 'Singles' Bowls.  You may choose to play 'First to 21', or a shorter game; 'First to 10'.

As in real life, you must choose your direction. The bowl always curves towards the centre as it slows down and you choose the weight, or strength of your shot.

Bowls is a rare simulation of the game of lawn bowls rather than the more common 'ten-pin' variety.

464045.overview:
Can you destroy the evil Brush Brigade? Or will you succumb to the dreaded Mini Tubes and Chattering Teeth?

To destroy the evil Brush Brigade, you must fire from your toothpaste tube. But take care, if you miss and hit the handles, the toothpaste rebounds on to you. The Mini Tubes also fire at you, but you can protect yourself with a Flouride Shield or fire back at them.

Beware at all times of the Chattering Teeth, they can penetrate your shield, and one bite is lethal.

464073.overview:
First it is important to realise that Spectrum Bridge Tutor is not a bridge playing program in the true sense. It is an interactive tutor comprised of a series of hands especially designed to illustrate particular aspects of bidding and card play. Because it is a Tutor only one bid, or card, ie, the correct one, can be made or played at each turn. This is not to say that another bid or card is incorrect but that it is not the recommended bid or card to lead through the aspect being illustrated.

The 40 hands, on both the Beginners and Advanced tapes, are independent of each other and there are no part-game scores carried from one hand to another.

The bidding system used is Acol, including a strong INT (16 to 18 points) opening at all times. The Blackwood and Stayman conventions are also used where appropriate. You are always South, and if dealer, you will open bidding.

For bidding, the display indicates the dealer, gives a bidding chart, and shows your hand. For the card play the display shows your hand again at the bottom of the table and North's hand at the top. Each card, as it is played, is displayed on the table. The display also shows the deal (hand) number, the contract and the number of tricks taken by North/South and East/West and who won the last trick.

At the end of card play an explanation is given of the bidding and card play. West and East hands are not shows in order to encourage you to picture the hands that they may hold from the evidence of your own and North's hand, any bids that they may have made and their play.

After the explanation you have the following options: re-read the explanation; replay the hand; load the next hand.

464283.overview:
BEING a BARON is never BORING!

Step back in time when the country was divided into huge estates...

Belligerent, bellicose Barons can hire mercenaries, buy weapons, plunder neighbouring land and crops, take slaves and generally create Bedlam!

Bashful, benevolent Barons can work the soil, harvest the crops to feed the workers and acquire more land legitimately!

Baron is a complex simulation game for up to four players, playing from 5 to 55 game moves. Each player controls his own Barony that he must control for the number of game moves chosen at the start. During each move each player may take the decisions he considers necessary to play his role successfully.

470875.overview:
The long awaited sequel to Forward to the Past, featuring music by the award winning Lee Bee!

Following Dave's botched attempt at time travel in 2021, a hole has appeared in the space time continuum. This has allowed an evil Baron to enter our realm, kidnap Dave and turn Nate into a bubble dragon, as that's the sort of messed up thing the Baron likes to do.

It's up to you, as Nate's bubble dragon alter ego, to collect 86 bubbles to break the Baron's spell. This will turn Nate back into a human kid, banish the Baron & remove Dave's cage, enabling you to go find and SAVE DAVE!

470877.overview:
The invaders had plundered the palace, destroying everything in their path. They had not only taken the lives of her people but had also endangered the most precious treasure of her lineage: the sacred bonsai collection, a symbol of her family's wisdom and history. It was said that each tree housed the spirit of an ancestor, and losing them meant condemning the legacy of generations.

Hidden in the shadows, she tied her hair, fastened her light armor, and covered her face with a black silk mask. She had been secretly trained in the art of ninjutsu, knowledge passed down by her father, who once told her:

"A warrior is not one who fights for vengeance, but one who fights to protect their legacy."

471235.overview:
Brag is a computerised version of the British card bluffing game that went on to spawn Poker.

The player takes on three computerised opponents, each of whom have their own style of play - ranging from very rigid to playing very loosely and the aim is to double your starting pot by winning as many hands as possible.

471567.overview: A specially designed Bob is your Question Master. This completely re-written version has at least 3,000 new questions including the Gold Run. Just as in the TV Quiz, you must forge a path across the hexagon to connect both sides of the matrix. Do not worry if your typing is not always accurate, the computer will often give you the benefit of the doubt. The winner of three games steps onto the Hot Spot in the Gold Run.

471574.overview:
Trivial Snooker on your computer. Snookered is a quiz game with a snooker backdrop. You start off attempting to pot a red ball, the computer will ask you a red ball question, which are general knowledge, not too difficult and worth - like the red ball in snooker - ONE point. The computer will show four answers (A, B, C or D) and you must choose the correct one. If you do then the red ball will be potted and you will move onto a colour of your choice (Yellow, Blue or Black); these  questions are worth the amount corresponding to the snooker ball of that colour - 2, 5 or 7 and are in an ascending order of difficulty and a lower time limit.

Once you have answered a colour ball question it's back onto a red ball, then a colour and so on. The game ends when you have potted 16 red snooker balls or when you have answered two questions incorrectly.

474501.overview: A classic platform/puzzle-style game that preserves the essence of 1980s games from the golden era of microcomputing.
